page.title: Code of conduct
page.lead: Lying about your role is part of the game; disrespecting other players is not. These rules apply to every game, public or private.

expected.title: What we expect from you
expected.respect: Respect the other players. Bluffing, accusing, defending yourself: yes. Attacking someone for who they are: no.
expected.hate: No hate speech: racism, antisemitism, homophobia, transphobia, sexism, mocking a disability. The chat refuses slurs of this kind outright.
expected.harassment: No harassment or threats, during the game or after it.
expected.cheating: No cheating: don't show your role outside the game (screenshot, call, messaging app) and don't coordinate outside the game.
expected.sabotage: Play for your side: don't deliberately sabotage your own team.
expected.spam: No spam: no repeated messages and no advertising.
expected.names: A decent name: no insults, no Nazi references, no name that imitates the moderators.
expected.age: The site is for people aged 15 or older.

tools.title: Your tools
tools.mute: Mute a player to hide their messages for you only, in this room only. They are not told.
tools.block: Block a player (with an account): you never see their messages again, in any room, and quick match keeps you apart. Manage your blocks on your profile.
tools.report: Report a player from the room: the moderators receive the last 100 chat messages, the public game log and the players' names. Without a report, the chat is kept only while the room exists.
tools.reportWho: You need an account to report, and so does the player you report. In a private room, the host can also remove a player.

moderators.title: What the moderators can do
moderators.rename: Change a name: the player gets a neutral name ("Player 12345") and may choose another one right away.
moderators.suspend: Suspend an account, for a set time or permanently. The reason and the end date are shown on the suspended account's profile.
moderators.accounts: Sanctions apply to accounts. Guests play only in private rooms, where the host can remove a player.

contact.title: Appeal a decision, report illegal content
contact.appeal: To appeal a moderation decision, write to <mail>{email}</mail> with your player name.
contact.legal: To report illegal content (EU Digital Services Act, or DSA), write to the same address: say where it is (room code, player name, date), why you believe it is illegal, and give your name and e-mail address.
